Course Hero is an online learning platform founded in 2006 and headquartered in Redwood City, California. It operates as a business of Learneo, Inc. The company describes itself as providing instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep materials, around-the-clock homework help, and tutors, positioning its service around on-demand academic support for students.

The held facts associate Course Hero with QuillBot, a paraphrasing tool categorized under writing and editing, listed at the coursehero.com domain. No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are present in the available data.
